total_supply_at_construction.meaning: totalSupply value pre-set by the HypoVault constructor
total_supply_at_construction.checkpoint: after constructor, before any deposit or fulfilment

vault_assets_at_construction.meaning: underlying assets owned by the vault at construction time
vault_assets_at_construction.checkpoint: after constructor, before any deposit or fulfilment

total_assets_before_first_fulfilment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV() equals assetsDeposited) before the first fulfilment

zero_shares.meaning: zero share supply required by the intent before assets exist

unbounded_loss_occurred.meaning: all subsequent deposits can be drained, i.e. unbounded financial loss materialized
unbounded_loss_occurred.checkpoint: after first fulfilment and subsequent deposits

assumptions: The constructor pre-set totalSupply of 1 000 000 is the share supply observable at the pre-fulfilment checkpoint.
totalAssets equals 1 before the first fulfilment as stated by the report.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the checkpoint at which totalAssets is measured relative to the deposit action, so the condition total_assets_before_first_fulfilment == 0 is not directly report-supported; the report instead states totalAssets equals 1 before first fulfilment.

The intent requires zero share supply while assets are zero, but the report's own P states totalSupply is pre-set to 1 000 000 and totalAssets equals 1 before first fulfilment; the correspondence between observed supply and expected zero supply cannot be faithfully conditioned on zero assets without inventing a checkpoint.

limitations: Impact modality is potential; the unbounded_loss_occurred Boolean records the reported potential outcome and does not assert inevitability.
Report does not give the exact share-minting formula operands beyond the 1-wei denominator.
Report does not state who triggers the first fulfilment or whether it is permissionless.
